title: Fix typos and unclear sentences in the Session 1 notes
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 notes may contain typos or sentences that a newcomer finds confusing.

## Context
Beginners judge the whole repo by Session 1.

## Expected outcome
A clearer `sessions/session-01/README.md` and `lesson.py` comments.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least three improvements
- [ ] `python start.py test` still passes

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add a colour-blind-safe palette to the gear apps
body:
## Problem
The apps colour the gears with a few translucent tints that some colour-blind users cannot tell apart.

## Context
Accessibility is part of the quality checklist (QUALITY.md, item 9).

## Expected outcome
A palette or outline style that keeps the gears distinguishable in light and dark mode.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-02/app.html`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Gears distinguishable in grayscale
- [ ] Screenshot added to the pull request

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add Session 4: helical gears and the contact ratio
body:
## Problem
The first roadmap milestone does not exist yet.

## Context
See `promo/roadmap.md`. The contact ratio of a spur pair is shipped in Session 2; helical gears raise it.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-04/` with README (sections A to F), lesson, checkpoint, exercises and app in the same style as Sessions 1 to 3.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-02/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Checkpoint prints PASS and the roadmap checkpoint is met
- [ ] Added to the tests

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Extend the search to three stages in line
body:
## Problem
`search_trains` handles two stages only.

## Context
Roadmap milestone 2. A naive six-gear search is too big, so a grouped search is needed.

## Expected outcome
A function that returns in-line three-stage designs within a tolerance.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/lesson.py`, `promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] A design within 1 percent of 1:100 is found
- [ ] Runs in under 20 seconds

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Reproduce the Target: the gearbox designer
body:
## Problem
The Target animation tours feasible gearboxes with turning teeth, a map and a speed-torque readout; there is no public implementation.

## Context
The code behind the Target is private on purpose. The roadmap gives the path.

## Expected outcome
Your own implementation, written from the roadmap, plus an animation like the Target.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] A tour of the in-line designs near a target ratio with meshing teeth
- [ ] Short write-up of your method

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Translate the Session 1 notes into Hindi
body:
## Problem
Students who prefer Hindi cannot read Session 1 comfortably.

## Context
This project teaches first- and second-year students across India; translations widen who can join.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-01/README.hi.md` with a faithful Hindi translation of sections A to F, linked from the main README.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All sections translated
- [ ] Equations, code blocks and file names unchanged
- [ ] Link added to the main README

## Difficulty
beginner
